name: @intellectual-frontiers/toolchain
description: Toolchain in the layers of Kanon: which programs a computer needs to do its work, declared once (a pinned version, a pin policy, a scope, the phase that needs it, and the bindings by which each dialect obtains it), resolved to the dialect that carries each out and planned; dialects are packages on the port of Desired OS State.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
